notes.title: Massive Last Train 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599980/be211a746e3248c922b7023de655a533f2fd0b60.png[/img]

We have been working on a huge update to The Last Train. This difficult pandemic period has given us an opportunity to look back at one of the most important games that we as a studio have worked on. Over the last few months we decided it would be a great time to revisit the game and try to improve many different aspects of the gameplay and the story.

Revisiting the game again gave us the opportunity to add new things we wanted to implement during development. We've also made many new quality of life improvements, bug fixes and most importantly listened to community feedback and implemented it.

Some of the major changes included are:
[list]
[*] Added random encounters in different stations
[*] Added a female voice over if you choose to play as a female character
[*] Every time you choose to drop a passenger halfway through the journey, you will have to be prepared to deal with the consequences
[*] Balancing fixes to the food, crafting, fuel, trains, etc
[*] Added over 99 new cooking recipes
[*] Removed the lockpick mini game
[*] You can now open all the trash cans with no tools
[*] Improved the quality of the art assets
[*] Added 64 bit support for Mac users
[*] All the trains are now only cosmetically different, so it doesn't give the players unfair gameplay advantages
[*] Made it easier to pick passengers from the station
[*] Re-balanced the coal rewards from passenger and scavenging
[*] Improved the pacing and progression of the story
[*] The upgrade system has been improved drastically
[*] Added a few tutorial prompts to introduce you to the radiation zone
[*] Streamlined the leaderboard options in the Sandbox mode
[*] See your previous best score and your current score in Sandbox mode
[*] Added a new achievements to the game
[*] And much more...
[/list]
To celebrate the launch of the brand new update we've slashed the price of the game. If you have any other features you want us to add please don't hesitate to get in touch with us at [b]hari@smashgamestudios.com[/b] or in the discussion boards. 

We would love to thank all of you for supporting us on this journey.

notes.title: Scavenger Update 1.1.0 launching December 11th
notes.content:
The scavenger update of the game will be launching on the 11th of December it will also contain a lot of the issues mentioned by the community. The major area of focus in this update was the addition of the Radioactive cities and radioactive suits. 

You will now be able to craft hazmat suits, which will allow you to explore parts of the city with heavy radiation. You will be able to get a lot more rewards from the buildings in that area since they will mostly be untouched by civilians.

Apart from this we've added a few mini games to which will reward you for successfully completing certain tasks like driving the train, chopping wood and lockpicking. 

As far as the fixes go we have made crafting a lockpick easier for the players, the balance for the food has also been fixed. The drop rates of iron ores have been increased so you can craft iron ingots and upgrade the train to have more passengers, improve fuel efficiency and most importantly the inventory spaces.

Finally we've also reworked the inventory system to support more stackable items in it. We noticed that a lot of the players had an issue running out of space in the inventory. Adding stackable items will allow the players to have more items at their disposal in their inventory right from the get go. However we made sure that making this change didn't really affect the balance of the game.

Our team has already started work on update 1.2 which will feature more new passengers and add more features which will make the game interesting for the user.

If you have any questions regarding the game kindly drop us an email at: hari@smashgamestudios.com

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Scavenger Update
notes.content:
Our Team is hard at work adding more content to the game and fixing some of the persistent bugs found by our community. Our main goal is to make sure we have a stable build when we release the update. We are calling the 1.1 Update the Scavenger Update. The major addition to this update is radioactive cities to the game. The player will be able to craft and get a hazmat suit from the survivors. You can use the hazmat suit to enter the radioactive zone within each of the 20 cities. It will be an area where you can spend a very limited amount of time scavenging, it is a high risk, high reward area in the game. Apart from this various new mini games have been added to the game to make it more engaging. Especially for when the train is moving, lockpicking and chopping down trees.

We have fixed numerous bugs and issues players have experienced earlier. We want the game development process of The Last Train to be transparent to all the members of the community. We will constantly be working on the game to be better and better. If you have any new ideas or mechanics you would like added to the game. Please don't hesitate to add them to the discussion section.

We are looking to get it done within a week or two.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is out!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce that our team has completed the first major update with all the fixes. 
We've addressed some of the major concerns that the users have had over the past few days. We are a small team of 3 developers we're trying to be very proactive and fix things as and when they appear.

In this update we've fixed a problem with the inventory, now you'll be able to stack all the items including tools on top of one another in the inventory. Right clicking on an item will remove an item from the inventory. Upgrading your inventory is also easier now, we've balanced it so you won't be needing too many materials to upgrade them. Apart from that we've improved the pacing of the story mode as well, to make the gameplay a lot better, you'll feel each passing story break will have a lasting impact on how you play the game.

Minor Bugs
- UI Issues have been fixed.
- Issue with the crafting has been resolved and we've also changed the crafting indicator to a green icon instead of the red whenever you have all the items necessary to craft items.

In case you have issues starting the game, please uninstall and reinstall the game.
